cookbooks.description: Duff's Omarchy customizations, one problem per recipe.

recipes.title: 1Password locks every time the screen locks
recipes.summary: A stand-in for the 1password command that ignores Omarchy's lock call.

recipes.title: Coding agent writes long, unwrapped, or file-list commit messages
recipes.summary: Give coding agents one global rule for commit messages.

recipes.title: Grok edits another project when a prompt goes to the wrong session
recipes.summary: Add a global Grok rule that ties each session to the repo it was started in.

recipes.title: Coding agent skips the Omarchy skill when working in a dotfiles repo
recipes.summary: Add a repo CLAUDE.md that tells agents to always load the Omarchy skill.

recipes.title: Bar and menu text too small, but the terminal font is fine
recipes.summary: Enlarge the shell font without changing terminals.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine (most noticeable on large external displays).

recipes.title: Bar clock shows 24-hour time
recipes.summary: Switch the bar clock to a 12-hour format.

recipes.title: Battery percentage not shown in the bar
recipes.summary: Show the battery percentage next to the bar's battery icon.

recipes.title: Make Caps Lock Escape on tap and hjkl arrows on hold
recipes.summary: Use keyd to make Caps Lock Escape on tap and a hjkl arrow layer on hold.

recipes.title: Chrome shows a privacy warning on a local Caddy HTTPS site
recipes.summary: Add Caddy's root certificate to Chrome's own store.
recipes.applies_to: Machines that serve local dev sites over HTTPS with Caddy.

recipes.title: Claude Code adds "Co-Authored-By: Claude" to my commits
recipes.summary: Turn off Claude Code's commit and pull request attribution.

recipes.title: Claude Code commits but doesn't push, or asks whether to push
recipes.summary: Make commit and push one step with a global Claude Code rule.

recipes.title: Claude Code changes made on Omarchy never reach my Mac
recipes.summary: Queue each Claude Code change as a GitHub issue in the Mac's config repo.
recipes.applies_to: An Omarchy machine plus a Mac (or any machine that does not run your Omarchy config).

recipes.title: Claude Code settings and rules don't follow me to my other machines
recipes.summary: Track three files from ~/.claude, plus ~/.bashrc, in a dotfiles repo, and leave the rest of ~/.claude out.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine (most useful with two or more Omarchy installs).

recipes.title: Claude Code keeps asking "How is Claude doing?"
recipes.summary: Turn off Claude Code's session feedback survey.

recipes.title: Claude sessions can't be reached from my phone, or all look alike there
recipes.summary: Turn on Remote Control at startup and name each session after its project.
runs: Remote Control, connected at the start of every Claude Co...

recipes.title: Claude Code's status line doesn't show the project or whether git is clean
recipes.summary: Show the model, effort, project, and a git check or cross in Claude Code's status line.

recipes.title: A Compose sequence types the wrong emoji, or the one I want is missing
recipes.summary: Override or add sequences in ~/.XCompose.

recipes.title: A Compose snippet with a line break comes out scrambled in Chrome
recipes.summary: Commit a placeholder and type the lines with an fcitx5 Lua add-on and wtype.
runs: the signature fcitx5 Lua add-on, loaded whenever fcitx5 s...

recipes.title: Clicking "Process crashed" starts an agent that may change files without asking
recipes.summary: Open the crash diagnosis agent in plan mode, from your config repo.

recipes.title: Ctrl+Enter toggles fullscreen in Ghostty instead of reaching the app
recipes.summary: Send Ctrl+Enter to apps as a CSI-u sequence instead of toggling fullscreen.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine using Ghostty as the terminal.

recipes.title: My Omarchy customizations don't follow me to my other machines
recipes.summary: A git overlay with a shared layer and a per-machine layer.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine (most useful with two or more Omarchy installs).

recipes.title: Desktop shortcuts appear in the home folder
recipes.summary: Create ~/Desktop and point the XDG desktop folder at it.

recipes.title: Dictation keeps recording after I let go of the push-to-talk key
recipes.summary: Rebind both ends of push-to-talk to ignore modifiers.

recipes.title: Dictation went into the wrong field and I have to say it again
recipes.summary: Add Super+D to retype the last dictation into the focused field.

recipes.title: ErgoDox EZ cannot be flashed or trained from Oryx
recipes.summary: Install ZSA's udev rules and add yourself to the plugdev group.
recipes.applies_to: ZSA keyboards (tested with an ErgoDox EZ).

recipes.title: Every display's bar shows the same workspace numbers
recipes.summary: Clone the workspaces widget so each bar lists only its own screen's workspaces.
recipes.applies_to: Multi-monitor setups that pin workspaces to screens.
runs: the cloned workspaces bar widget, which reads the rules w...

recipes.title: High-DPI gaming mouse moves the cursor too fast to place it precisely
recipes.summary: Give the mouse its own acceleration curve, precise when slow and far on a flick.
recipes.applies_to: High-DPI gaming mice (tested with a Razer Viper V3 Pro).

recipes.title: git push over HTTPS fails after syncing ~/.config/git/config
recipes.summary: Commit a credential helper that calls gh by name, and keep the sync script from dropping it.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine (most likely with two or more Omarchy installs).

recipes.title: Hard to see which window is focused
recipes.summary: Widen the window borders.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine (most noticeable on large or high-DPI screens).

recipes.title: Herdr's agent list keeps reordering itself
recipes.summary: Group Herdr's agent panel by workspace so its order stays put.

recipes.title: Herdr closes a workspace, pane, or tab without asking
recipes.summary: Turn Herdr's close confirmation back on and unbind the pane and tab close keys.

recipes.title: Herdr has no shortcut to jump between agents
recipes.summary: Put the previous and next agent on Alt+Up and Alt+Down, and workspaces on Alt+Shift.

recipes.title: Herdr tab names don't show which tab is running an agent
recipes.summary: Rename the tab while the agent runs.

recipes.title: HiDPI screens are left on auto scale instead of a fixed 2x
recipes.summary: Pin every screen's scale to 2 instead of auto.
recipes.applies_to: Machines where every screen is a 2x ("Retina") panel, such as a Dell XPS 16 with Apple Studio Displays or a Pro Display XDR, or a MacBook Air.

recipes.title: Moving the mouse or brushing the touchpad steals keyboard focus
recipes.summary: Make keyboard focus follow clicks, while hover still scrolls.

recipes.title: Intel laptop screen stays black after undocking with the lid shut and sleeping
recipes.summary: Keep the panel off while the lid is shut, and turn it back on after the wake.
recipes.applies_to: Laptops with Intel graphics used docked with the lid shut (tested on a Dell XPS 16).

recipes.title: Laptop used as a headless server sleeps when the lid is shut
recipes.summary: Ignore the lid and allow only key logins over SSH.
recipes.applies_to: A laptop kept closed on a shelf and reached over SSH (tested on a T2 MacBook Air).

recipes.title: Laptop Wi-Fi falls back to slow 2.4 GHz with the lid shut, or never joins 6 GHz
recipes.summary: Switch the saved Wi-Fi profile to WPA3 and pin it to the 5 GHz band.
recipes.applies_to: Laptops used docked with the lid shut on a tri-band (2.4/5/6 GHz) router (tested on a Dell XPS 16 with Intel BE211 Wi-Fi).

recipes.title: A launcher shortcut opens a second window instead of focusing the open one
recipes.summary: Rebind shortcuts, and rewrite every web app launcher, to focus the open window by its class.
runs: focus-webapps.path, a user systemd path unit that reruns ...

recipes.title: A lone window fills the whole screen in the scrolling layout
recipes.summary: Turn off fullscreen_on_one_column so a single window keeps its column width.

recipes.title: MacBook T2 trackpad moves the cursor while typing
recipes.summary: Tag the trackpad as internal, and with keyd, pause it after each key with a small daemon.
recipes.applies_to: Intel MacBooks with a T2 chip (tested on a MacBook Air, USB id 05ac:027a).

recipes.title: mailto: links open in Chrome instead of HEY
recipes.summary: Put HEY back as the mailto handler and keep it there after updates.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine that uses Google Chrome as the default browser.

recipes.title: mise upgrade skips a release that just shipped
recipes.summary: Turn off mise's release cooldown and track the global mise config.

recipes.title: Monitors swap left and right when the cables change ports
recipes.summary: Pin each screen by make, model, and serial instead of by port.
recipes.applies_to: Desks with two or more external displays, especially identical ones (tested with two Apple Studio Displays on a Dell XPS 16 over Thunderbolt).

recipes.title: No Print Screen key for screenshots
recipes.summary: Put Omasnap on Super+Shift+S and in the Capture menu.
recipes.applies_to: Keyboards without a Print Screen key (many laptops, Apple and split keyboards).

recipes.title: No shortcut to open a typed or pasted URL (or search the web)
recipes.summary: Super+U opens an address or searches the web.

recipes.title: A prompt typed into the wrong Claude session changes the wrong project
recipes.summary: Have Claude stop and ask when a prompt is meant for another project.

recipes.title: Reboot from the menu, or Ctrl+Alt+Delete, closes everything without asking
recipes.summary: Add confirmations to Reboot in the menu and to Ctrl+Alt+Delete.

recipes.title: Reminder notification disappears after 5 seconds
recipes.summary: Make reminder toasts critical, so they stay up until dismissed.
runs: Drop-in for every omarchy-reminder-*.service user unit th...

recipes.title: Putting Compose on Right Alt breaks Right Alt as a modifier
recipes.summary: Make Right Alt Compose on tap and Alt on hold, with keyd.
recipes.applies_to: Machines that move Compose from Caps Lock to Right Alt.

recipes.title: Screensaver starts too soon while reading
recipes.summary: Set longer idle timers for the screensaver and the lock.

recipes.title: Scrolling direction feels backwards on the touchpad and mouse
recipes.summary: Turn on natural scrolling for both the touchpad and the mouse.

recipes.title: SSH key has to be created or copied onto every Omarchy machine
recipes.summary: Point SSH at the 1Password SSH agent, so one key serves every machine.

recipes.title: Super+J shows a Lua error on a scrolling-layout workspace
recipes.summary: Only toggle the split on dwindle workspaces.

recipes.title: Super+Shift+arrow only swaps windows, can't move one into another's space
recipes.summary: Bind Super+Ctrl+Shift+arrow to move a window into its neighbor's split.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine using the dwindle layout (Omarchy's default).

recipes.title: Super+Slash made everything bigger, and it stays that way after reboot
recipes.summary: Put the saved monitor scale back, and optionally turn off Super+/.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine (a "watch out" note, not a config change).

recipes.title: Swap Alt and Super on the laptop keyboard but not on an external keyboard
recipes.summary: Swap the keys in a keyd config that matches only the laptop keyboard.
recipes.applies_to: Laptops used with a separate external keyboard (tested on a Dell XPS 16 with an ErgoDox).

recipes.title: Bar is missing a widget you want, or shows one you don't use
recipes.summary: Enable, disable, or add bar widgets with omarchy plugin.
installs: a third-party shell plugin from git, if you add one
runs: a third-party shell plugin, inside omarchy-shell, if you ...

recipes.title: A light palm tap on the touchpad clicks things
recipes.summary: Turn off tap-to-click so only a physical press clicks.

recipes.title: Two web app windows for the same site share one login or get mixed up
recipes.summary: Give a second account its own Chrome profile, and mark a local copy with a colored border.

recipes.title: Dictated text types out slowly, one character at a time
recipes.summary: Set Voxtype's typing delay to zero.

recipes.title: Voxtype keeps mishearing the same word
recipes.summary: Map each misheard spelling to the right word in text.replacements.

recipes.title: One Voxtype config on machines that need different Parakeet models
recipes.summary: Switch Voxtype to Parakeet and keep the model choice per machine.
recipes.applies_to: Every machine with Voxtype dictation, most useful with several machines.

recipes.title: A web app opens every link in a new window, or sends links out to a browser tab
recipes.summary: Open the site in a regular browser window, or install it as a real Chrome app.
installs: Chrome web app (Install page as app)

recipes.title: Windows app in Wine is tiny, blurry, or draws hair-thin lines on a HiDPI screen
recipes.summary: Draw at 96 DPI in Wine and let Hyprland double it with sharp pixels.
recipes.applies_to: Windows apps run under Wine on 2x screens (tested with a stock market trading app that is only available for Windows, a .NET WinForms program, on Apple Studi...

recipes.title: Wine app quits on Super+W, or pops back up after you hide it
recipes.summary: Show and hide an all-day Wine app with one key, and make Super+W hide it instead of closing it.
recipes.applies_to: A Windows app under Wine that you keep open all day (tested with a stock market trading app that is only available for Windows, spread across two Apple Studi...

recipes.title: Workspaces open on unpredictable monitors
recipes.summary: Give each monitor its own block of workspace numbers.
recipes.applies_to: Setups with two or more monitors.

recipes.title: Wrong default microphone: dictation and calls record silence when docked
recipes.summary: Raise the WirePlumber priority of the microphones you want as the default.
recipes.applies_to: Machines with several audio inputs, such as a laptop on a dock with a webcam and monitor microphones (tested on a Dell XPS 16 with a CalDigit TS4 dock, a Log...
